planning_decisions: §8.3 [提案] の実装。1アプリ=1カードで裏の複数レイヤー（§7 home.packages + Sd44947 共有 device 金型）を1枚に集約。
install 適用は S673a42 の GUI キック nixos-rebuild を流用、共有トグルは Sd44947 の shared_dirs（palmux-shared profile）を再利用（priority_rule 6）。ゆえに S673a42 + Sd44947 に依存。
§8.2 に従い構造化データを正とし .nix を一方向生成（手書き .nix の双方向パースはしない）。
従属ルール（未 install→共有グレーアウト）+ 全コンテナ一律（金型=単一プロファイル維持）を §8.3 のルール通り実装。
§8.3 の当初想定『フォルダ共有=要 rebuild（重）』は Sd44947 で hot 化されたので実態（hot）で表示し、設計ドキュメント §7/§8.3/§8.4 の陳腐化マーカー（[提案]→[実装済]、/etc/palmux→/persist）も本スプリントで是正（ドキュメントと実装の乖離を残さない）。
マイルストーン扱い（§8.3 全体の実現、ユーザ可視の大きな機能でレビュー境界が妥当）。実機検証は green（priority_rule 9）。
prototype_review_decisions: 実現性レビュー(ユーザ質問): コード確認で AC-S41bdf2-1-1『共有 /nix 経由で全コンテナ+ホストに反映』の前提が現状 FALSE と判明。コンテナは Ubuntu 24.04 + apt でツールは palmux-ws image 焼き込み(images/workspace-default/build.sh)、/nix も ~/.nix-profile も無い(incus.go:1079 が明言)。palmux-shared プロファイルは ~/ghq/.claude/.local/bin/dotfiles/gh/ssh のみで /nix/store を共有していない。

決定(ユーザ選択): install スコープ = /nix/store 共有を実装(AC 忠実)。palmux-shared 金型に /nix/store(read-only)+ Nix profile bin を追加マウントし container PATH に載せる。Nix バイナリは patchelf 済みで自前 /nix/store 依存を持つため Ubuntu コンテナでもそのまま動く。→ install=home.packages 追加→nixos-rebuild→共有 /nix/store 経由で真に『1回で全コンテナ+ホスト』。これは既存タスクに無かった実装作業なので S41bdf2-1 にタスク追加(AC は据え置き、AC が常に含意していた container 到達を満たすための欠落タスク補完)。

決定(ユーザ選択): install パッケージ入力 = カタログ + 検証付きユーザ入力。既知アプリ(infisical/gh/awscli2/1password-cli)はキュレート済みカタログ。ユーザ定義は適用前に `nix eval nixpkgs#<name>` で attr 解決を検証し、無ければ rebuild を走らせずインラインエラー(GET/POST /api/apps の validate 経路)。

Q2(config↔app 紐付け)の答え: Sd44947 shared_dirs は今はパス平坦リストのみでアプリ紐付け無し。カタログ(app id→{package, authConfigPath})を新設し、共有トグルは同一 shared_dirs(単一 source)へ該当パスを書く(カードと汎用共有フォルダリストが一致=AC-2-1)。紐付けは我々のキュレート規約であり Nix/アプリの self-declare ではない旨をユーザに明示済み。エクスポーズ自体は Sd44947 機構の再利用で現行実現可能(bind-mount, Nix 非依存)。
priority_rule 6 遵守: /nix/store 共有も Sd44947 の palmux-shared 金型(ReconcileShared)に device として足す(新機構を作らない)。read-only + 冪等 reconcile。
implementation_decisions: App install-state store = config.toml [apps] with [[apps.installed]] records {id, package, authPath, custom}. Known apps have a code-side catalog (id→display/icon/package/authPath); custom apps carry their own package+authPath. Share state is NOT stored in [apps] — it is derived from [workspace].shared_dirs so the app card's share and the generic 共有フォルダ list are a single source (AC-2-1). Rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES 6 (reuse Sd44947 shared_dirs) + 7 (explicit single source, no divergence).

Drop-in generation (§8.2 one-way): palmux2 (Go) writes <flakeDir>/local/20-apps.nix = `environment.systemPackages = with pkgs; [ <pkg>... ];` from [apps].installed packages, then kicks the EXISTING S673a42 palmux-rebuild.service via deploy.TriggerRebuild (priority_rule 6 — no duplicate rebuild plumbing). flakeDir default /persist/palmux/nixos (appliance convention), env override PALMUX_NIXOS_FLAKE_DIR (priority_rule 7, no hardcode-only). Chose environment.systemPackages over home.packages because the appliance uses systemPackages (no home-manager on the OS; examples confirm) — it is the AC's '相当の宣言'. Reaches HOST via /run/current-system/sw/bin and CONTAINERS via the shared /nix/store + sysbin mount.

Go writes the drop-in itself (not the rebuild unit) so the WHOLE install→rebuild path is exercisable by the branch binary on green WITHOUT releasing a Nix-module change (green runs the fetchurl-pinned module; only its palmux2 binary and the palmux-owned drop-in files are branch-controllable). The rebuild unit stays the released fixed unit that just runs `nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#appliance`; listFilesRecursive ./local picks up 20-apps.nix. Product change needed (ships next release): appliance.nix state-init must chown <flakeDir>/local to the palmux user so palmux2 can write 20-apps.nix. For the green smoke this dir-ownership bootstrap is prepared by hand (documented in green-smoke.json) because a Nix-module change is unreleasable mid-sprint — the load-bearing Go logic (drop-in write + rebuild kick + /nix reconcile) is exercised for real.

/nix sharing (S41bdf2-1-4, priority_rule 6): extend shared_profile.go declaredDevices() to add nix-store {source=/nix/store, path=/nix/store, readonly} + nix-sysbin {source=EvalSymlinks(/run/current-system/sw/bin), path=/run/current-system/sw/bin, readonly}, GATED on /nix/store existing (only NixOS appliances). The sysbin source is the RESOLVED store path so a generation change after nixos-rebuild changes the source string → the existing reconcile source-diff replaces the device (10s self-heal) → new packages hotplug into running containers. Also set incus profile environment.PATH to prepend the nix bin dir (design doc §6 future form prescribes environment.PATH exactly). All read-only, idempotent, inside the palmux-shared mold (no new mechanism). Non-nix hosts (dev/deploy-test) have no /nix/store → devices+PATH not added → behavior unchanged.

nixpkgs name validation (S41bdf2-1-5, priority_rule 7): POST /api/apps/validate runs `nix eval --raw nixpkgs#<name>.name` (charset-guarded name [A-Za-z0-9._-]) BEFORE any rebuild; non-zero → inline error, no rebuild. nix binary path overridable via PALMUX_NIX_BIN for dev E2E (dev Ubuntu box has no nix). When nix is unavailable the endpoint returns a distinct 'nix unavailable' result (never a silent pass).

Install on a non-NixOS host persists the [apps] install intent + returns needsRebuild with a message (mirrors public.domain's root-class UX) but does not rebuild — lets dev E2E drive available→installed via config persistence while green does the real rebuild. installing/error states are covered by frontend mock tests (two-tier testing).

API: extend GET /api/deploy compatibly is NOT used for apps; add a NEW /api/apps surface (GET list, POST /api/apps/install, /api/apps/uninstall, /api/apps/share, /api/apps/validate) per the forbidden-list rule 'add /api/apps, extend /api/deploy compatibly'. No existing response shape changed.
verification_decisions: Green real-appliance smoke (AC-S41bdf2-3-3) RAN on green.tjstkm.net (real palmuxOS). Non-destructive branch-binary method (S673a42 pattern): staged branch binary, runtime-masked+stopped managed palmux2, chown'd flake local/ to palmux (simulating the appliance.nix state-init change that ships next release), ran full install→nixos-rebuild→in-container-run→share-on/off→uninstall, then byte-restored the palmux-shared profile + flake dir + restarted managed palmux2. LOAD-BEARING /nix-store-sharing risk RESOLVED: both host Nix coreutils 9.7 (pre-install) and GUI-installed infisical 0.41.1 (post-rebuild) RUN inside the Ubuntu container. green left healthy. Full log: green-smoke.json.
review_decisions: Independent verifier (separate read-only session): overall PASS. 0 AC failures, 0 overlooked, 0 forbidden, 0 ADR conflicts. 1 warn on AC-3-3 (literal-browser-vs-API wording on green) — verifier judged the green smoke a GENUINE real-appliance run (real store paths, container name, generation hashes, load-bearing check done twice), the two caveats honestly disclosed; recommended accept-as-is. Accepted.

Correctness reviewer (high effort) found 3 real bugs, all FIXED with regression tests: (1) LOAD-BEARING settlePending async-start race — `systemctl start --no-block` returns before the unit is `activating`, so the first post-install poll could read the PRIOR run's terminal Result and settle prematurely (silent-swallow a failed rebuild, or spurious error). Fixed: pending install now holds 'installing' until the rebuild is OBSERVED running (pendingSeen) with a 30s grace fallback; List state 'installing' keyed on the pending marker not a transient rebuildRunning sample. Tests: TestInstallDoesNotSettleOnPriorResult + updated TestInstallCatalogAppNixOS/TestShareDependsOnInstall drive the real lifecycle. (2) `_`-prefixed custom app id unaddable (ValidPackageAttr allowed leading `_` but ValidAppID rejected it) → aligned appIDRe to accept leading underscore. Test: TestCustomUnderscorePackageInstallable. (3) FE toast + debounce timers not cleared on unmount (setState-on-unmounted) → added useEffect cleanup for both. All refuted candidates (env.PATH churn, nix-sysbin generation replace, injection, share off-by-one, deadlock) confirmed non-bugs by the reviewer.
fix_cycle_decisions: AC-S41bdf2-4-1 (nix-PATH real bug): nixvalidate.go now resolves nix via resolveNixBin() — LookPath(bin) first (bin=default "nix" or PALMUX_NIX_BIN override), and when the default is not on PATH, falls back to well-known ABSOLUTE candidates in order: /run/current-system/sw/bin/nix, /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix, $HOME/.nix-profile/bin/nix (first that exists via os.Stat). Rationale: palmux2 runs as a systemd service whose PATH omits nix (palmux.nix), so plain LookPath fails on the real appliance and every validation wrongly returned Unavailable. Priority_rule 7: the PALMUX_NIX_BIN seam is preserved and an explicit (non-"nix") override is honoured EXACTLY (no fallback) so an E2E fake is never shadowed. None-resolvable -> Unavailable (never a silent valid). The charset guard is unchanged and still runs first.

AC-S41bdf2-4-1 (module side, belt-and-braces): palmux.nix service path list now includes config.nix.package so a rebuilt appliance has nix on the service PATH natively; the binary absolute-path fallback is what makes older/unrebuilt hosts work without a rebuild.

AC-S41bdf2-4-2 (authPath edit): new additive endpoint POST /api/apps/{id}/auth-path {authPath} → Controller.SetAuthPath. $HOME scope enforced SERVER-side by reusing Sd44947 config.ExpandSharedDir (out-of-$HOME -> error -> 400), so the client hint cannot be bypassed (priority_rule 5/6). The override is persisted in apps.json (InstalledApp.AuthPath); for catalog apps it shadows the catalog default, for custom apps it replaces the stored value. List() now returns the EFFECTIVE authPath (override-or-catalog). Editing is dependent on install (mirrors Share 従属): an un-installed app has no record -> 400. Existing /api/apps response shape unchanged (additive only).

AC-S41bdf2-4-2 (shared_dirs follow, priority_rule 6): if the OLD auth path is currently shared, SetAuthPath moves the share to the NEW path in the SAME shared_dirs single source (drop old abs, add new abs via the existing SharedDirsPort.ApplySharedDirs) so the card and the generic 共有フォルダ list stay consistent + running containers hot-refresh. Not-shared apps touch no containers (returns 0).

AC-S41bdf2-4-2 (UI): apps-section.tsx share row gained an inline edit affordance (data-testids share-path-edit/-input/-save/-cancel-{id}) shown only once installed. Client-side reuses shareScopeError for a live $HOME hint and disables save on out-of-scope/unchanged/empty (server remains authoritative). Optimistic + specific inline error surfacing (share-path-error-{id}) per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES. New CSS classes match the Fog palette (pathRow/pathEdit/pathInput/pathBtn/pathBtnGhost/pathEditBtn/pathErr/pathHint).

AC-S41bdf2-4-3 (tests): Go TestResolveNixFallback (fallback resolves a stubbed absolute candidate; none -> Unavailable; explicit override no-fallback) + TestSetAuthPath ($HOME reject + override persist + share-follow) + TestSetAuthPathNotShared. Playwright E2E tests/e2e/s41bdf2_authpath_edit.py (real backend, [AC-S41bdf2-4-2]) + mock tests/e2e/s41bdf2_authpath_edit_mock.py (input-state machine) + server-side reject checks appended to tests/acceptance/s41bdf2_apps_backend.py. All exit 0 against isolated dev instance (INSTANCE=dev, portman port 8205, --config-dir ./tmp).

Optional nicety (out of scope for behavior): WriteDropin now returns a clearer permission-denied error mentioning appliance state-init (appliance.nix palmux-state-init chowns <flakeDir>/local) instead of a bare mkdir/write errno. No behavior change; only the error string. Did NOT attempt to fix the .44 controller-built env gap (per scope).
